Message.MsgText: Initializing QRadar Connector version version, LEEF Version supported is LEEFversion, syslog output: boolean.

Explanation.p: An Exception was thrown when closing the LEEF file.

OperatorResponse.p: Examine the exception for more details about the problem.

Message.MsgText: Too few tabs (min=3) found in line: line

Explanation.p: While reading a LEEF file, a line was found that contained less than 3 tab separated fields.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the input file is a proper LEEF file.

Message.MsgText: LEEF Version should be version, in line line

Explanation.p: While reading a LEEF file, a line was found that did not have the correct LEEF version.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the input file is a proper LEEF file with the correct version.

Message.MsgText: Required LEEF Header Attribute missing from Output Map: name.

Explanation.p: The output entry did not contain the named attribute. This attribute is required.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the output map creates all the required attributes.

Message.MsgText: Attribute devTime missing from Output Map. Custom attributes detected: attributes.

Explanation.p: When the output entry contains custom attributes, the LEEF Header Attribute devTime is required.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the output map creates the devTime attribute.

Message.MsgText: Renaming first LEEF file to file name.
Event number number, changing to LEEF file file name.
The attribute name has more than length chars: value.

Explanation.p: The named attribute contains too many characters.

OperatorResponse.p: Reduce the length of the string.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name is not numeric: value.

Explanation.p: The named attribute must be an integer.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the attribute is an integer.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name has a value value which is outside the accepted range minimum to maximum.

Explanation.p: The named attribute has a value that is outside the permitted range.

OperatorResponse.p: The value should be between the minimum and the maximum.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name is not a valid date: value.

Explanation.p: The named attribute must be a valid date.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the attribute is a date that can be parsed.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name is not a valid IP address: value.

Explanation.p: The named attribute must be a valid IP address.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the attribute is a valid IP address.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name is not a valid MAC address: value.

Explanation.p: The named attribute must be a valid MAC address. It should consist of 6 parts separated by either : or -, each part should be two hex characters.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the attribute is a valid MAC address.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name is not a recognized protocol number: value.

Explanation.p: The number used for the protocol was not recognized.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the attribute contains a valid protocol number or keyword.

Message.MsgText: The attribute name is not a recognized protocol keyword: value.

Explanation.p: The name used for the protocol was not recognized.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the attribute contains a valid protocol number or keyword.
